fail_closed_rules: Missing, non-finite, non-positive or insufficient samples fail validation.
The direction of improvement must be declared for each metric.
A candidate gate is not a hosted soak, national-scale measurement or release qualification.
A failed comparison remains recorded and must not be replaced by a selected passing run.
non_claims: No timing dependency, benchmark service or external library is required by this contract.
The gate does not establish resource, cost, production or national-scale capacity.
